decision.statement: 3HP is the working candidate and the default for the generated artwork, supports and CAD. 2HP is not declared infeasible: the selected 2HP arrangement clears every nominal transverse margin, but its worst-corner margins stay negative, driven by the INFERRED jack-axis height and the ASSUMED lead trim and hole tolerances. It stays a fully parameterized open candidate and reopens on the evidence in the break-even table. The controller outline in Y-Z is common to both widths.

candidates.selection_rule_2hp: Among 2HP offsets x PCB thicknesses with trimmed leads, keep only rows whose nominal margins are all >= 0 and whose nominal nut edge margin meets the R1 preferred 0.3 mm; pick the row with the largest worst-corner minimum hard margin, then the largest nominal minimum margin, then the thicker PCB.
candidates.selection_rule_3hp: 3HP centred with the thickest PCB option that is FEASIBLE ON PAPER with untrimmed leads (no factory trim dependency).

adapter.reason: moves the unchanged A5 power adapter 2.0 mm toward the PMMA so a 2.4 mm gap opens between its rear face and the leaf front edge; the controller-to-leaf SH4 harness leaves the emission corridor at the leaf plug mouth and runs in that gap instead of descending beside LED D2 (R2-C6)

load_path: Plug insertion (+Z, R1 5-10 N): barrel -> front nut -> PMMA front face -> rack screws.
Plug withdrawal (-Z): body front face -> PMMA pocket floor (rear-pocket) or PMMA rear (plain).
Nut torque: rectangular body in the rear pocket keys rotation (plain alternate: PCB + spine slot, i.e. through the solder joints).
Lateral plug load: barrel in the 6.2 mm hole, clamped by the nut; PCB solder joints only see the residual.
Controller PCB: held by the two clamped jacks at the bottom and the spine slot (Y50-72) at the front edge; Z retention by the jacks.
Setting switch: actuation force along Z into the SMD body and its two pegs -> PCB; force not sourced.
Optical stack: top cap -> M2 into the spine post at Y20.5 (A5 topology); bottom cap located by its fork on the controller rear edge; no jack load enters the optics.
